injuries.

Ear plugs is necessary when working around loud noise
environment

or hot surfaces

Antiseptic hand sanitizer with broad-spectrum antimicrobial
properties, provides instant protection by killing germs

Masks and respirators are effective at reducing transmission
of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19, when worn
consistently and correctly.

Handwashing with soap remains one of the best defenses
against the virus.
